court.name: Supreme Court of the United States

opinions.text:
The petition for writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Second Circuit is struck from the docket upon the ground that the petition is not presented by or on behalf of the United States, the party to the record.
Messrs. Horace M. Gray and Charles E. Wythe for petitioner. Mr. Edgar J. Treacy for respond-, eht.

attorneys: Messrs. Horace M. Gray and Charles E. Wythe for petitioner. Mr. Edgar J. Treacy for respond-, eht.
